scene.name: The Boy Who Understood Grief
scene.text: The Golden Child finds a mourner alone near the graves. He offers a flower and sits quietly. After a while, the villager begins sharing memories of someone lost. The boy listens until sunset.

text_only.reason: a gentle narrative scene; the source gives no effect
